# shipd_approval_policy (Resource)

Configures one shipd approval policy using an API that supports Terraform approval policies. Use an organization-wide service-account token with approval_policy:read for import and refresh and approval_policy:update for writes. Creation and updates require Enterprise. An enabled policy can be strengthened in place. Weakening, disabling, or removing an enabled policy requires an organization administrator or owner in shipd. Destroy permanently removes a disabled policy. Policy changes make pending requests stale. Reviewers decide newly submitted requests in shipd.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "project_id" {
  type = string
}

variable "production_environment_id" {
  type = string
}

resource "shipd_approval_policy" "production" {
  name                   = "Production flag review"
  description            = "Require two reviewers for changes in production."
  project_ids            = [var.project_id]
  environment_ids        = [var.production_environment_id]
  environment_production = true
  required_approvals     = 2
  reviewer_roles         = ["owner", "admin"]
  allow_self_approval    = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Policy display name.

### Optional

- `allow_self_approval` (Boolean) Whether an otherwise eligible human requester can review their own flag request. Defaults to false.
- `description` (String) Policy description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the policy is enforced. Defaults to true. Create a disabled policy to stage changes.
- `environment_ids` (Set of String) Environment IDs to match. An empty set matches any environment. When project_ids is set, every environment must belong to a selected project.
- `environment_production` (Boolean) Match production when true or non-production when false. Omit to match either.
- `min_rollout_increase` (Number) Minimum rollout increase in percentage points from 0 to 100. Omit for no threshold. The threshold applies to flag reviews.
- `priority` (Number) Evaluation priority from 0 to 10000. For flag reviews, the first enabled match governs and lower numbers run first. Defaults to 100.
- `project_ids` (Set of String) Project IDs to match. An empty set matches any project in the organization.
- `required_approvals` (Number) Number of distinct human approvals required, from 1 to 20. Defaults to 1.
- `reviewer_roles` (Set of String) Eligible organization roles. Choose admin, owner, or both. Defaults to both.
- `reviewer_team_ids` (Set of String) Additional teams from which eligible organization reviewers may be selected. Defaults to an empty set.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable approval policy ID.
- `updated_at` (String) API timestamp used to detect concurrent changes.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import \
  -var='project_id=PROJECT_ID' \
  -var='production_environment_id=ENVIRONMENT_ID' \
  shipd_approval_policy.production POLICY_ID
```
